digitizer.shingling_gate: PASSED — 0 uncited verbatim runs >=8 words over the assembled 17-skill pack (2026-08-18, w=8, max-quote=25, source=books/ai-apps/corpus whole book; leg 1: 37 md files / 157681 shingles vs 101988 source 8-grams; leg 2: the 17 evals/routing.yaml copied to *.md because the checker walks only *.md, 8702 shingles). Both legs 0 violations. NOT scanned by construction: sources.json and package.json (not markdown; stage-authored metadata, not book prose).
digitizer.routing_gate: PASSED 17/17 (CP3.5 wave 2, 2026-08-18) — activation 97.7% (216/221) vs >=80%, sibling-steal 1.8% vs <=10%, 0/152 hard-negative violations, 0/373 judge fallbacks, on the full 17-skill catalog (70 entries) with a single cross-family judge; wave-1 regression 104/104. Discrimination probe (boundary clauses + triggers ablated): 91.9% activation / 6.3% steal — the NOT-clauses are load-bearing at 17 skills, unlike at 8. Single judge this wave; wave-1's second weaker oracle was NOT repeated. See ROUTING-GATE.md for limitations.
digitizer.not_consumed_note: the remaining KUs are the glossary/definition units recorded in reduce-report.md §6 as outside every thematic cluster — no skill grows from them. All 17 thematic clusters are now distilled.
digitizer.l0_benchmark: Skills: 17  Pass rate: 89% (301/340) — 12 A, 5 B (reproducer: dz benchmark packages/@dzhechkov/skills-book-ai-apps --all). The 5 B grades are exactly the 5 SKILL.md bodies over the harness U5 bound of 50000 BYTES (harness-core/src/benchmark.ts).

distribution.rationale: CP5 taken after the second wave completed: the pack ships our own page-anchored reformulations (KUs) and decision skills, not the book text — the shingling IP gate passes at 0 uncited verbatim runs >= 8 words — so the methodology is publishable while the corpus stays owner-local.
distribution.note: CP5 TAKEN. private:true and publishConfig.access=restricted were the structural pre-decision guardrails; both are lifted by this recorded decision. The book corpus itself is NOT distributed — only paraphrased KUs and skills.

lookup_tiers.references: ALWAYS — each skill ships its consumed KUs in full at <skill>/references/knowledge-units.md, inside the pack
lookup_tiers.corpus: owner-local only — books/ai-apps/corpus/*.md in the digitizer workspace
lookup_tiers.brain: AVAILABLE since CP6 (2026-08-19). The pack ships the per-book KB slice at brain/ai-apps.sqlite (223 KU, lexical-only for portability, IP-gated like the rest of the pack). Load it with: dz brain add --from-pack @dzhechkov/skills-book-ai-apps — an idempotent upsert on (book, ku_id, corpus_version) into YOUR ~/.dz/brain, which re-embeds the vectors locally. Then dz brain query "<q>" --source ai-apps and dz brain ground answer from the brain in ANY project. NOTE: dz recall --books reads the PROJECT store (.dz/memory/books.sqlite), not the brain — the cross-project verbs are dz brain query / ground / primer.
